mentions.name: Daylight Goals
mentions.description: This iOS app pushes users to spend more time outdoors in the sun, using automatic time-in-daylight tracking via Apple Watch and Apple Health. A major update reorganizes the app and adds more dynamic notifications.
mentions.source_excerpt: Daylight Goals ( https://daylightgoals.com ) - I’m releasing a major update later this month, it is an app built around pushing you to spend more time outdoors in the sun, using automatic time in daylight tracking via the Apple Watch & Apple Health. The update reorganizes the app and adds a lot more dynamic notifications.
